excluded: J1 (the repository's store: run the test), J4 (seeded mutations: generated by the test, --seed), J6 (third_party/primitives and tests/vectors already carry them), J7 (the reference crashes there)
rule: Each gzipped line is {class, name, case, expect}. A case {lines: [base64 line bytes, newline included], blobs: {name: base64}, trust, profile, as_of} is assess(snapshot of the lines and blobs, trust, profile, as_of) (docs/V3.md §10); a case {package, trust, profile} is handoff inspect alone (§13). expect is the answer of the Python reference: a report, {refused: why}, a handoff result or {error, message}, with the engine's identity left out (assessment, code; adapter). An implementation agrees when every member of its answer but those is canonically equal to expect's (RFC 8785, docs/V3.md §1) and its own assessment is the SHA-256 of canon({snapshot, trust, profile, as_of, code}) with its own code.
